integrity: The infinite-family assertion is proved analytically. Finite computation is used only for replayable sanity checks and not as evidence of exhaustiveness or impossibility.
scientific_limitations: For dimensions at least four, the all-body higher-order unbalanced comparison remains open; only the simplex-profile theorem is unconditional there.
For dimensions at least three, the maximizing parameter is given implicitly as the unique positive zero of the displayed polynomial rather than by a general radical expression.
A residual literature risk is an unindexed application of general Bernstein variation-diminishing theory to the identical geometric profile.
title: Strict unimodality of the simplex higher-order unbalanced-difference profile
